## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改一个测试文件。两个“已保存的数值区间”用例改为等待带类型的数字输入框(`spinbutton` 角色)出现后再断言 `toHaveValue(5)` / `toHaveValue(1)`。
- 为什么改:控件先用已保存的值画出区间行,`age` 的 number 类型要等异步的 `getObjectSchema` 返回才生效;在那之前框是文本框,值是字符串 "5"。原测试 `findByLabelText` 拿到第一个框就断言,在慢机上与 schema 赛跑,队列构建 44173515593 因此误踢 PR #34955。
- 风险与回滚:零产品风险,不改任何发布代码;回滚即还原这一个测试文件。断言没有放宽,仍要求数字 5。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx` 的 `findTypedBound` 及两处调用。
- 两分钟验证:把该文件的 `getObjectSchema` 改成延迟 300ms 返回后跑 `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx`,预期 14/14 通过(修复前同样改动会在 :174 报 `5 (string)`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The stored-criteria `between` tests asserted a typed value straight after `findByLabelText`. `FilterConditionField` seeds the row from the stored value at once, but `age` is typed `number` only when the async `getObjectSchema` answers; until then `FilterBuilder` draws the bound as a text box holding `"5"`. The test now waits for the typed box itself (`findByRole('spinbutton', { name })`), via one helper `findTypedBound`, in both tests of this file that had the race (`:174` `To`, and `:198` `From` in the blank-bound migration test).

No skip, no retry, no quarantine; `toHaveValue(5)` and `toHaveValue(1)` are unchanged.

Widget reading: after the schema lands the bound IS a number input showing the number, so no product change and no changeset. The untyped text box exists only in the window before the schema answers (see Acceptance notes).

- Leg A, test as on base 444301463 plus delay: `Tests 2 failed | 12 passed (14)`. `:174 expect(element).toHaveValue(5)` Expected `5 (number)`, Received `5 (string)`, the queue signature exactly; and `:198 toHaveValue(1)` Received `1 (string)`.
- Leg B, test at 6dffff81d plus delay: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`.

## Acceptance notes

- Same race, other file, not changed here (scope is this file): with the same 300 ms delay, `FilterConditionField.emptyOperators-10790.test.tsx` fails 6 tests (`findByDisplayValue('5')` then an edit expects `"amount":6`, receives `"amount":"6"`), and `FilterConditionField.builderRows-8748.test.tsx` fails 1 (`findAllByRole('combobox')` then `toHaveTextContent('Name')`, receives empty). Both are latent copies of this flake.
- Widget behaviour in the pre-schema window: an edit typed into a number bound before `getObjectSchema` answers is emitted untyped (the emptyOperators probe above emits `"amount":"6"`). Measured only through the unit harness; not reached through a running app.
- Type check of the test project (`type-check`) and the full UI farm are left to CI (`Type Check UI`, `Test UI`).
